name: Eyes of the Dead (Necromancy, Vitreous Path, Basic)

system.description: Requires a wraith nearby. By spending a Mental Trait, the necromancer borrows a wraith's Deathsight, perceiving a subject's general health, injuries, illness, likelihood of imminent death, and curses or hostile enchantments, in either the Shadowlands or the living world. Particularly subtle readings may require a Static Mental Challenge (retest with Occult). Lasts one scene or one hour, whichever ends first, though the necromancer may end it early.
